feature: ordinary Channel nested weighted_target core runtime

contracts: all configured children leave IDLE instead of the first success monopolizing readiness
only READY child pickers contribute configured weight
the selected child delegates to child-local picker state
configuration state outlives the caller's service-config object

implementation.ownership: runtime deep-copies every target path string and recursively frees it transactionally
implementation.warming: each RPC attempts every currently eligible static endpoint before selection
implementation.budget: one warming pass is capped by connection_attempt_delay and the caller's earlier absolute deadline
implementation.aggregate: nested children expose READY, CONNECTING, IDLE, or TRANSIENT_FAILURE from their matching slots
implementation.weighted_pick: one random sample spans only READY child weights
implementation.pick_first: child-selected slot remains sticky while its connection is reusable
implementation.round_robin: child cursor advances only after a successful local pick
implementation.failure: an unavailable high-weight child contributes no range and cannot consume the whole RPC deadline

negative_boundary.hostname_targets: ordinary weighted-target currently requires static resolved endpoints

native_cases: three real h2c endpoints warm automatically on the first RPC
the low-weight target delegates through a nested target to two round-robin endpoints
400 RPCs observe a bounded 1:3 parent distribution
the nested round-robin endpoints differ by at most one request
ServiceConfig is destroyed immediately after Channel initialization
a weight-100 unavailable child receives zero picks while a weight-1 READY sibling completes every RPC
runtime construction passes every induced allocation failure
verification_commands: zig build test-lib -Dtest-filter='gRPC ordinary weighted target' --summary all
zig build test-lib -Dtest-filter='ordinary weighted target runtime deep copy' --summary all
remaining_gap: ordinary least-request, ring-hash, WRR, outlier and hostname runtime support remain before broad parity
